headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.16
summary: Discord presence fixes from the first field test: the logo now displays, login survives launcher restarts, and elapsed time tracks the launcher session.

items.text: The Discord presence logo was missing; it is now registered as an external asset on each connection instead of relying on an asset key the gateway ignores.
Discord login no longer resets on every launcher restart; the session identity is restored from the gateway and tokens are saved before the profile fetch.
Elapsed time on the launcher presence now counts from app start instead of an internal timestamp.
